column4: a donor dependency that the owner uses through one method (ChunkStore.get(hash) -> byte[] or null) is mapped onto the JDK interface with that contract (Map<String, byte[]>, Map.get) by a TYPE row whose target is a parameterized type, plus an IMPORT row; the store itself stays a Synexia owner; the test's two constructor lines are SUBST rows

column4: the module lint -Xlint:all,-module -Werror refuses a public class in an exported package without an explicit constructor ([missing-explicit-ctor]); the donor relied on the default constructor, so an AFTER row inserts the explicit public no-argument constructor after the class line (same visibility and behaviour), counted in the provenance inserts column

column4: the donor files are CRLF while the repository stores LF (core.autocrlf=true on this host normalizes on add: the earlier lanes' CRLF targets are LF blobs on master, M3HammingTopK.java CR count 0), and a checkout may show either: the recipe writes LF (what the repository stores) and --check compares LF-normalized bytes, so a CRLF or LF checkout is a fixed point; target_sha256 in PROVENANCE.tsv is the LF digest (git show <rev>:<path> | sha256sum on any host)
